items.title: Deadline to file Widerspruch against the accident recognition decision
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde, Widerspruch erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Fri 20.11.2026, sent by an authority by ordinary post (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X), explicitly confirmed by the letter itself ('ist er am vierten Tag nach dem Absenden bekannt gegeben'): deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting = Tue 24.11.2026 (no weekend/holiday shift applies to this deeming rule). The one-month Widerspruch period starts the day after deemed delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X), i.e. from 25.11.2026, and ends one month later on the day with the same number (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) = Thu 24.12.2026. That day (Christmas Eve) is a normal working day in Germany (not a statutory public holiday), so no further shift is needed.

warnings: No payment is requested in this letter; the IBAN printed in the footer is only the Unfallkasse's own account for information and is not a reason to send any money.
